newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Feb paper exports through ports up 25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Feb paper exports through ports up 25 pct.

text.p: Finnish paper exports through ports increased 25 percent year-on-year in February to 689,400 tonnes, the Board of Navigation said in a monthly review released on Wednesday.
In January-February, paper exports through ports at 1.46 million tonnes were 26 percent higher than in the year-ago period, the board said.

Overall, Finnish exports through ports rose 23 percent year-on-year to 2.87 million tonnes in February and total exports through ports in the first two months of the year were up 17 percent at 5.81 million tonnes, the board said.
Total Finnish imports through ports increased 6.7 percent year-on-year in February to 2.40 million tonnes and January-February imports through ports rose 11.5 percent to 5.19 million tonnes, it said.
About 80 percent of Finland's foreign trade passes through ports.
